subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – autoresponder email
body_text:
Hi Rohan,

Thank you for your time on our call. Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option, which had been off, in your form settings and saved it.
- Following our guidance, you filled in a test form with your other email, and you confirmed the autoresponder email arrived and is now working.

What we covered:
- Emails can sometimes go to spam, so it is good to verify your sender domain, which you can do in Settings in the email domain section.

Your next steps:
1. Verify your sender domain in Settings, in the email domain section (you mentioned you would do this tomorrow morning).

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-04

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
